Disclaimer: These deuterocanonical books are recognized as Scripture by the Catholic and Eastern Orthodox churches but are not included in the Protestant Old Testament. They were written during the intertestamental period (roughly 300 BC – 100 AD) and are found in the Greek Septuagint and Latin Vulgate but not in the Hebrew Masoretic text. They are presented here for study and reference.
